title: Deep-learning ageing marker from retinal photographs predicts morbidity and mortality
summary: Trained on UK Biobank, RetiPhenoAge predicted cardiovascular disease, cancer and mortality risk beyond other markers in three independent cohorts (UK Biobank, SEED, AREDS). Numeric effect sizes were not read.
ai_technology: Deep convolutional neural network (RetiPhenoAge) predicting PhenoAge from retinal photographs
organization: Singapore Eye Research Institute, Singapore National Eye Centre; Duke-NUS Medical School

evidence.tested: Three independent cohorts (UK Biobank, SEED, AREDS)
evidence.unknown: Numbers not read; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning RetiPhenoAge from retinal photographs predicts biological ageing, morbidity, mortality

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
